_doc: Fixer registry (#137, campaign epic #136). One entry == one gate-scoped
appearance; multi-stage conversations are separate entries whose
name           display name shown in the bar
base           base id placement; matches bare id or id_<suffix>
offer          offer line ('' / absent = pure dialogue)
accept_actions [..] run on ACCEPT: plot verbs or campaign tokens
done_actions   [..] run when a pure-dialogue conversation ends

fixers.name: Ernesto Sandoval
dialogue: You look like a pilot who could use honest work. Ernesto Sandoval. I deal in... acquisitions.
I have a consignment of iron that needs to reach Liverpool, over in the Newcastle system. Forty units, no questions, no trouble.
Fifteen thousand credits. I don't have it on me - you'll be paid when you return to New Detroit. You have my word.
fixers.offer: Haul 40 units of iron to Liverpool (Newcastle system), then return here for 15,000 credits. Deal?

fixers.name: Tayla
dialogue: Looking for Sandoval? Don't bother. He's dead. Word is it wasn't an accident.
Name's Tayla. Sandoval owed people, and now those people are curious about that trinket he handed you as collateral.
My advice? Keep the artifact. It's worth more than his fifteen grand ever was - and it's yours now, like it or not.
If you want to know what it IS, I can point you at people who find things out. But my help isn't free. Come see me when you're ready to work.
